citations.quote: FHS combines model-based methods of dynamic variance, such as GARCH, with model-free methods of distribution

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: FHS standardizes returns by a GARCH variance forecast to extract i.i.d. shocks, resamples those shocks model-free, and re-inflates by tomorrow's forecast variance to compute VaR/ES at any horizon, per Christoffersen Ch.6.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Filtered Historical Simulation (FHS)
